senses.gloss: m. (רָתַף) store-room, cellar where vessels are stored in rows and layers.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:1">Pes. I, 1</cite> <he>שתי שורות על פני כל המ׳</he> the two rows of piled vessels in front of the cellar.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:18">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של חומץ</he> a store-room for vinegar.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:8">Lev. R. s. 24</cite>, end; a. fr.
